en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town taken from a field in the foreground. The middle distance shows detached houses with steep gabled roofs and trees, while the background is a dense historic townscape of brick and plastered buildings. Dominating the skyline are several large Gothic church towers and spires; on the right stands a massive brick hall‑church with a stepped‑gabled façade and another stepped‑gabled building attached. The image has no visible captions or border text on the front side.
